rationale: Observed armour crossing the obstacle belt at Verbove on 20–21 Sept supports Tarnavskyi's claimed breakthrough there.
A control claim from Jan 2026 and the road role of the same villages in Dec 2025.
A's 02:48–02:56 tracks west from Krolevets into Chernihiv Oblast are part of B's cruise wave.
A loss count and a pre-strike inventory at one base are different quantities.
Two or three drones a minute over the highway explains why daytime movement on it was impossible.
B's report of Popov crediting the minefields supports A's description of him celebrating the minefield defence.
Popov's memo blaming his 'highest boss' fits his firing by the defence minister after he raised problems.
Town coordinates and a driver estimate of the launch-point distance do not test each other.
The 458 deaths, 419 of them by weapons, corroborate the killings that the withdrawal revealed.
Russia's claim to have killed the landing party corroborates that a HUR landing took place in late October 2025.
Same Prigozhin claim that he and Surovikin planned 'Operation Bakhmut Meatgrinder' in October 2022.
Same report of Zelensky thanking the 46th and 77th for holding Soledar on 12 Jan 2023; B has more sources.
Different drone tracks at different times.
HUR gives the same figure of about 3,000 Geran-4/5s a month in both.
B adds the destination (the Orikhiv axis) of the 76th VDV transfer from Kreminna.
Delta's history and Aerorozvidka's 2022 targeting are different assertions.
The road reopening date and the defenders' order of battle.
Both date Popov's dismissal to 11–13 July 2023; a one-day difference is reporting slack.
B describes how the 21 Aug cut to Kolodiazi closed (pincers from Nove and the west, a loose ring).
Unit size and a raid description from the same account.
The commitment of 1st Azov Corps to Dobropillia is the premise of Axe's argument that the salient kept Azov out of Pokrovsk.
Kupiansk road links and the Russian aim at Lyman.
A covers all bases on 1 June; B covers Olenya on 3 June. The scopes differ.
B gives the length of the Antonov-airport-to-Prybirsk extent that A observes on Maxar imagery.
Geolocated Ukrainian advances near Ridkodub and Nove cast doubt on the Russian MoD's capture claim, which used older footage.
Same report of Pavlii replacing Sak at the 47th Brigade on 16 Sept 2023.
A loss count and a pre-strike inventory are different quantities.
The emblematic image of a Leopard 2A6 and Bradleys south of Mala Tokmachka is consistent with heavy Bradley and Leopard losses on 8 June.
B gives a more detailed sequence of how mines, drones, shells and Ka-52s stopped the columns south of Mala Tokmachka.
A loss floor and base coordinates.
Both report Storm Shadow strikes on Russian headquarters in 2023.
Commanders briefing Putin on 24 Aug implies their units were in Kursk Oblast by then.
Same Kyiv Post report of a Lancet hitting an 82nd Brigade Stryker near Robotyne on 15 Aug 2023.
B builds a causal assessment on A's report; A does not make B more likely.
Both report the Trump–Putin meeting in Alaska on 15 August 2025.
A adds the areas claimed (75 km² cleared plus 10 km² liberated) to the same 15 Sept announcement.
Milblogger reports of fighting on the Zherebets after the salient was cut are consistent with ISW's assessment that the line was levelled along the river.
A loose ring is consistent with most of the Russians escaping toward the Zherebets.
TWZ's note of many Tu-95MS recently arriving at Olenya corroborates the Russian claim of 11 Tu-95MS there.
The plan's main axis and the road geometry are different assertions.
